name: Storyteller {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Narrative truth, structure, voice and consent.

commands.name: /story
commands.does: Orients: reads intent, contract and story class, then routes.
commands.returns: The routing decision and the next decisive question or action.

commands.name: /story-setup
commands.does: Establishes the operator's context, register and boundaries.
commands.returns: The working defaults for voice, privacy and stakes.

commands.name: /mine
commands.does: Mines raw material for the specific change under meaningful pressure.
commands.returns: Candidate moments with their tension, cost and meaning.

commands.name: /interview
commands.does: Interviews without contaminating memory, one open question at a time.
commands.returns: Recalled material in the user's own words, quotes marked only when confirmed.

commands.name: /moment
commands.does: Captures one moment as the seed of a story object.
commands.returns: A moment card with what changed, what it cost and what is unresolved.

commands.name: /deepen
commands.does: Reveals desire, obstacle, stakes, belief, choice and consequence.
commands.returns: The deepened story object with its unresolved edge named.

commands.name: /shape
commands.does: Selects the smallest useful architecture and the scene order.
commands.returns: The structure with the reason this architecture was chosen.

commands.name: /hook
commands.does: Builds openings that earn the next sentence.
commands.returns: Hook options, each stating the promise it makes.

commands.name: /scene
commands.does: Builds a scene from observable detail only.
commands.returns: The scene, plus the details it declined to invent.

commands.name: /arc
commands.does: Maps the arc and throughline across several story objects.
commands.returns: The arc with its repetitions and its gaps named.

commands.name: /cowrite
commands.does: Co-creates structures, beats, questions and neutral fragments.
commands.returns: Options and fragments, with the next decision left to the user.

commands.name: /write
commands.does: Drafts the deliverable under an explicit WRITE contract.
commands.returns: The draft in the user's register, non documented elements labelled.

commands.name: /rewrite
commands.does: Rewrites an existing draft while preserving language and intent.
commands.returns: The rewrite with what was preserved and what changed.

commands.name: /voice
commands.does: Diagnoses voice fidelity against the user's writing and Brand voice rules.
commands.returns: A voice report and the exact lines that drifted.

commands.name: /adapt
commands.does: Moves a story to another channel preserving story DNA.
commands.returns: The channel version, and what was preserved versus deliberately lost.

commands.name: /content
commands.does: Produces the content shaped version and hands it to Content {OS}.
commands.returns: The piece plus the story object reference it publishes against.

commands.name: /keynote
commands.does: Shapes a story for a stage, with beats and timing.
commands.returns: The talk structure with timings and the beats most at risk.

commands.name: /pitch
commands.does: Shapes a story for a pitch with the ask in its place.
commands.returns: The pitch narrative, the ask, and the claims it leans on.

commands.name: /brandstory
commands.does: Shapes the origin and purpose story of the company.
commands.returns: The brand story, and any conflict found with the live claim.

commands.name: /customerstory
commands.does: Shapes a customer story from verified outcome evidence and consent.
commands.returns: The customer story with evidence and consent scope, or a refusal.

commands.name: /datastory
commands.does: Connects a data pattern to a human consequence.
commands.returns: The data story with every number traced to its source.

commands.name: /truthcheck
commands.does: Separates fact, memory, inference, interpretation and invention.
commands.returns: Truth class per element, load bearing risks, and a hold at VERIFY when needed.

commands.name: /score
commands.does: Scores structural completeness only.
commands.returns: The score, what is missing, and what the score does not measure.

commands.name: /rehearse
commands.does: Tests delivery: clarity, movement, timing, breath and ending.
commands.returns: Rehearsal notes and the beats where the room is lost.

commands.name: /feedback
commands.does: Compares audience reception with intent.
commands.returns: The gap between intent and reception, and the story object update.

commands.name: /storybank
commands.does: Operates the durable bank of story objects.
commands.returns: Records with truth classes, consent scope and version history.

commands.name: /repurpose
commands.does: Finds the stories worth telling again, and where.
commands.returns: Ranked candidates with the adaptation each needs and its consent scope.

commands.name: /story-review
commands.does: Issues the release verdict for a story on a specific surface.
commands.returns: READY, READY WITH CUTS, NEEDS TRUTH CHECK, NEEDS DEEPENING, WRONG STORY FOR THIS JOB, or DO NOT PUBLISH.

handoffs.artifact: voice rules a story may not contradict
the claim a story may support
consent status of any named third party
verified customer outcome evidence for customer stories

requires_human_approval_for: moving from COACH to WRITE or EDIT
naming any third party in a story, on the exact surface it appears on
publishing a remembered, interpreted or composite element as fact
releasing a customer story, which needs recorded consent and outcome evidence
overriding a DO NOT PUBLISH or NEEDS TRUTH CHECK verdict
storing anything marked private into the shared story bank
retiring or rewriting a story object version another OS already consumed
